record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare WATER_SHURIKEN: Froakie (1 star), Frogadier (2 stars), Greninja (3 stars); all range 1, maxPP 80. Froakie and Frogadier also declare passive HATCH (not covered here); Greninja has none. The strategy is shared; unit differences are only the star count. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Three rays from the caster toward the board edge: one in the direction of the cast target (one of 8 compass directions from the signs of the coordinate differences) and the two neighbouring directions in OrientationArray (45 degrees to each side). Every enemy on any cell of the three rays takes SPECIAL damage (raw 20/40/60 by stars), with no falloff and no range limit. The caster is turned to face the cast target as a side effect.

targeting.who: every enemy-team unit on the three rays; allies are skipped, rays are not blocked by units
targeting.note: The target only fixes the central direction (the signs of dx and dy), not an exact line: unless the target stands on a straight or exact diagonal line from the caster, it is not on the central ray and is then hit only if it happens to lie on one of the three rays. The strategy passes an Orientation, so the 'touch the original target' fallback of effectInOrientation (only for entity arguments) does not apply. If caster and target share a cell, board.orientation picks a random direction for a confused caster and otherwise logs an error and returns DOWNRIGHT.

geometry.shape: three rays from the caster's cell to the board edge: the central direction D and the two directions next to D in the circular order DOWN, DOWNRIGHT, RIGHT, UPRIGHT, UP, UPLEFT, LEFT, DOWNLEFT; no maxRange argument is given. The board is 6 rows x 8 columns: the RIGHT ray is bounded by board.rows (6) instead of board.columns (8) in the source as written, so a RIGHT ray stops at x = 5 and misses columns 6 and 7 for any caster; the other rays use rows / columns correctly (UP uses rows, UPRIGHT and DOWNRIGHT use columns, UPLEFT uses rows).

effects.target: each enemy on any of the three rays
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The three rays start from the caster's cell in three different directions and do not share cells, so each enemy is hit at most once per cast. No heal or kill trigger follows in this strategy.

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (120, also the ?? fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Geometry, range and maxPP (80) are the same for the three units.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemies are hit depends on the caster and target coordinates (the central direction from the signs of dx and dy) and on the board edge. Any ray pointing RIGHT (the central ray, or a side ray when the central direction is UPRIGHT or DOWNRIGHT) is cut at column 5 by the board.rows bound; the other rays reach the edge. If caster and target share a cell the central direction is random for a confused caster and DOWNRIGHT otherwise.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP, overwrites the caster's orientation and recomputes the rays.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: raw SPECIAL damage 20/40/60 (1/2/3 stars) to each enemy on three rays. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then special-defence division and a minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Which enemies receive it is the geometric result of the three rays on the 6x8 board, including the RIGHT-ray bound.
